doc.title: Carmen Caramanica interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, July 27, 2011

title: Hiring Rick Montalbano as pianist
summary: His first act as musical director was bringing in Rick Montalbano on piano.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Yeah. It’s nice to be part of his story in a positive way. And I forgot that you had Don Alias on that gig. He was a great guy too. And then you brought Rick [Montalbano] into the band, is that right?

Yeah, that was my first official act. When the piano player/conductor left and they said okay they want to make you the musical director, of course we’ve got to find a piano player. And I said “got the guy.”
So I almost, without even asking permission from Lou, I said “I’ve already got a piano player.” And he said “oh, okay.”
Yeah okay. I remember that specifically.
